contentCheck.notes: Crop omits the beaker figure (saturated CuSO4(aq) with solid CuSO4 crystals); page context shows it.

primary.evidence: Saturated solution in contact with solid keeps constant ion concentration at fixed temperature as water evaporates; excess solid precipitates.

supporting.evidence: Must treat the saturated solution as a dissolution equilibrium with the solid.

uncertainty: Could also be argued as le-chatelier or dynamic-equilibrium primary.
